title: Lakehouse Proxy Routing & Read-Only Config
summary: Dataproc Metastore introduces new Lakehouse proxy routing capabilities for phased migrations to Iceberg REST Catalogs. The new `LakehouseProxyConfig` and its properties are now officially read-only, which is a breaking change if you were previously attempting to configure them.
details:
A significant new capability has been added to Dataproc Metastore: Lakehouse proxy routing. This enables phased migrations where namespaces can be moved from Dataproc Metastore to a Lakehouse Iceberg REST Catalog in batches. The metastore service can now operate in a `PROXY` state, forwarding requests for migrated namespaces to the Lakehouse catalog while serving unmigrated ones locally.

This update introduces the new `LakehouseProxyConfig` schema and integrates it into the `Service` resource via the `lakehouseProxyConfig` property. Developers should note that the `catalog` and `namespaces` properties within `LakehouseProxyConfig`, as well as the `lakehouseProxyConfig` property itself within the `Service` schema, are now explicitly marked as `readOnly`. This is a breaking change if any existing integrations or preview code were attempting to set or modify these properties; such operations will now fail. These fields are intended to reflect the current state of the proxy configuration, not to be directly configured via the API.
